name: Hobgoblin area
accessNote: Hobgoblins in the Edgeville Dungeon (non-Wilderness section) and on the peninsula west of the Crafting Guild. Not the Wilderness hobgoblin spawns. The Slayer task/Hobgoblins table (pageid 298252) lists Edgeville Dungeon and the Crafting Guild peninsula as cannonable and safespottable (single-combat).
